TextBlock.Text: ARAFURA SEA, 0540 local. MV Coral Pioneer missed her rendezvous forty minutes ago. Her last report mentioned an engine casualty and an escort claiming the authority to inspect the convoy. The Indonesian patrol sent to investigate has reported gunfire and nothing since. You are the escort, with your embarked Seahawk if you sailed with one, a Poseidon on task for the first part of the morning and a Triton high to the north. Bring the merchants together and walk them north-east to the handover box. Your merchants are Coral Pioneer, the bulker Gove Trader, the chartered coaster Jeparit and the relief freighter Sunda Relief. Ahead of them are two trawlers, and a scheduled Denpasar flight is overhead. One contact in that picture is a Meridian escort with weapons and one is a container hull putting out the radars of a warship it is not - do not let your ESM operator pick the wrong one. Your weapons are tight.
Commodore Alex Mercer, Maritime Border Command, Darwin

Get the crews out of danger and the merchants into the handover box. Identify before you shoot: a dead fishing boat ends this operation and starts something worse, and a Meridian escort that gets away is a problem for another day. Coral Pioneer is the ship this morning is about; bring her in.

Convoy: Walk three of the four merchants, Coral Pioneer among them, into the north-eastern handover box Neutrals: Harm no neutral shipping or aircraft Warramunga: Bring your flagship out intact Identify: Classify the Meridian escort before the handover

Your escort group and its MH-60R if embarked, one P-8A on task, one MQ-4C Triton overhead. Four merchant hulls to collect; two trawlers and an airliner on the track; one armed Meridian escort and one decoy.
50 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.

U.S. Navy 2027 Capabilities mod, Boeing P-8 Poseidon, Merchants Expanded, Auxiliary Merchant Pack, RE-power: the resupply mod, Civil Aircraft Mod (Airbus Family), Red Storm Arsenal, the base game, this pack.
